description: This script tests the cellular manager's ability to check if the SIM card slot is active and to retrieve the operator name, using tdklib and sysutil modules.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: A wrapper class for TDK test components, used to load modules and create test steps.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific commands.

methods.name: addParameter
methods.description: Adds parameters to the test step, such as commands to execute.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test case with expected result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the test execution.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Gets detailed output from the executed command.

methods.name: setResultStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the test step as SUCCESS or FAILURE.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Checks if a module loads successfully.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the load status of a module.
